skill.name: copywriting
skill.description: Writes and improves conversion-focused website copy for homepages, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, product pages, and about pages.
skill.summary: Create clear, structured website copy with persuasive headlines, benefits, calls to action, and supporting sections.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: All nine static findings are false positives caused by ordinary copywriting prose and Markdown code formatting. No executable commands, reconnaissance behavior, malicious intent, or prompt injection were found.

content.value_statement: Website copy often hides the product value or gives visitors no clear next step. This skill creates structured, audience-focused copy that supports action.
actual_capabilities: Writes complete page copy organized by headline, subheadline, calls to action, and supporting sections.
Rewrites existing website copy for clarity, specificity, active voice, and stronger customer benefits.
Creates two or three headline and call-to-action alternatives with concise rationale.
Adapts copy for homepages, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, product pages, and about pages.
Produces optional page titles and meta descriptions when search content is relevant.
limitations: Requires product, audience, offer, proof, and page-goal context for tailored copy.
Does not verify claims, statistics, testimonials, customer research, or legal compliance.
Focuses on website pages, not email campaigns, popups, offer design, or detailed copy editing.
Provides copy options but does not measure conversion impact without external testing.

use_cases.title: Launch a SaaS landing page
use_cases.description: Create a focused page with a value proposition, benefit sections, objection handling, and one primary call to action.

use_cases.title: Rewrite a pricing page
use_cases.description: Clarify plan differences, recommendation cues, common objections, and calls to action for easier purchase decisions.

use_cases.title: Explain a product feature
use_cases.description: Turn technical details into customer benefits, practical use cases, and clear paths to try the feature.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a homepage hero
prompt_templates.prompt: Write homepage hero copy for [product] serving [audience]. Provide one headline, one subheadline, and three specific call-to-action options.

prompt_templates.title: Improve existing copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite [current copy] for [audience]. Preserve verified claims, replace vague language, emphasize benefits, and explain the main changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a landing page
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a landing page for [offer] from [traffic source]. Address [objections], use [proof], and focus every section on [primary action].

prompt_templates.title: Develop an evidence-based page
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a complete [page type] for [product], using [research]. Address [objections], cite only supplied proof, annotate key choices, and provide alternatives.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create advanced copy from customer research.

output_examples.input: Write hero copy for LedgerLane, an expense platform for finance teams that spend hours chasing receipts.
output: Headline: Close the month without chasing receipts
Subheadline: LedgerLane collects expense documents, flags missing details, and keeps every approval visible.

output_examples.input: Rewrite this pricing CTA for a project tool with a 14-day trial: Sign up now.
output: Supporting text: Explore every feature before choosing a plan. No payment details required.

output_examples.input: Turn this feature into customer-focused copy: Automated reports arrive every Monday.
output: Section heading: Start Monday with the numbers ready
Body: Receive a current report before your first meeting, so you can review results instead of preparing spreadsheets.

best_practices: Provide the primary audience, page goal, offer details, objections, and verified proof before requesting a draft.
Use customer language from interviews, reviews, and support conversations when you have permission to share it.
Test headline and call-to-action alternatives with real visitors before choosing final copy.
anti_patterns: Do not invent testimonials, statistics, customer quotes, guarantees, or product capabilities.
Do not request persuasive copy without identifying one primary audience and one primary action.
Do not treat generated copy as validated conversion performance or legal approval.

faq.question: Which pages can this skill write?
faq.answer: It supports homepages, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, product pages, and about pages.

faq.question: Can it improve copy I already have?
faq.answer: Yes. It can rewrite supplied copy for clarity, specificity, active voice, stronger benefits, and clearer calls to action.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, page type, primary action, offer, differentiators, objections, traffic source, brand voice, and verified proof.

faq.question: Does it create SEO content?
faq.answer: It can provide a page title and meta description when relevant. It does not perform keyword research or technical SEO audits.

faq.question: Will it create statistics or testimonials?
faq.answer: No. Supply verified evidence and approved customer quotes. The skill advises against fabricated claims because they damage trust and create legal risk.

faq.question: Does generated copy guarantee more conversions?
faq.answer: No. The skill applies copywriting principles, but conversion impact requires testing with real visitors and reliable measurement.
